data.narrative:
Exolaunch is a bootstrapped Space & Aerospace company founded by Dmitriy Sternharz and Dmitriy Bogdanov, both with TU Berlin space tech backgrounds. The valuation universe comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Traditional peer-median triangulation is not applicable. The broader Space & Aerospace sector contains 14 same-sector peers, but none satisfy clustering criteria at matching stage or valuation tier—a minimum of 3 datapoints is required for statistical reliability. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples likewise cannot be applied; while the public Space & Aerospace universe trades at a median 25.3x P/S across 6 tickers, Exolaunch's revenue is not disclosed, as is typical for private companies at this stage.

Without applicable quantitative methods, a triangulated valuation range cannot be supported by the data provided. Any valuation estimate would rest on qualitative factors—founder pedigree, technology differentiation, market timing—rather than empirical multiples or comparable transactions. The key uncertainties are Exolaunch's current revenue run-rate and profitability trajectory, disclosure of which would enable public-comp anchoring. A peer transaction analysis of the private Space & Aerospace cohort would also strengthen anchoring, conditional on deal transparency.
